select twd.id, twdd.id as detailId, twd.so_id as soId, twd.code, twd.dict_platform as platform, sb.shop_id as shopId, twd.so_code as soCode, twd.platform_code as platformOrderCode, sb.shipping_order_no as thirdCode, twd.status, sbl.code as transportNo, twd.track_no as trackNo, sbl.logistics_channel_id as channelId, sbl.logistics_channel_name as channelName, twdd.sku_no as skuNo, twdd.platform_sku_no as platformSkuNo, twdd.delivery_qty as qty, twdd.warehouse_id as warehouseId, twd.create_time as createTime, sb.so_outstock_date as outstockDate, sb.sign_order_error as signOrderError from third_warehouse_delivery twd inner join third_warehouse_delivery_detail twdd on twd.id = twdd.main_id and twdd.is_deleted = false
inner join erp_oms.so_b2c sb on twd.so_id = sb.id and sb.is_deleted = false inner join erp_oms.so_b2c_logistics sbl on sbl.main_id = sb.id and sbl.is_deleted = false
inner join so_b2c sb on twd.so_id = sb.id and sb.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_logistics sbl on sbl.main_id = sb.id and sbl.is_deleted = false
where ${params.sqlMap.default} and twd.is_deleted = false order by twd.create_time desc
select status as tabFlag, count(1) as count from third_warehouse_delivery where is_deleted = false group by status
mapper.update: update third_warehouse_delivery twd set track_no = so.track_no, update_time = now(), version = twd.version + 1 from so_outstock so where twd.id = so.source_id and so.source_type = #{sourceType} and twd.is_deleted = false and so.is_deleted = false and coalesce(twd.track_no, '') = '' and coalesce(so.track_no, '') != '' and twd.create_time >= #{startTime} and twd.create_time < #{endTime}
